facts.statement: Racing, demolition derby, soccer and housing were announced as coming to Free Realms over summer 2009.
facts.quote: Racing, soccer, housing and more coming to Free Realms this year.

article_summaries.title: The Future of Free Realms - A Video Q&A with Andy Sites
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer video Q&A (filmed at E3 2009) with Free Realms Senior Producer Andy Sites, posted June 9, 2009. It states that SOE had passed 2 million Free Realms players and that racing, demolition derby, soccer and housing were planned for summer 2009, plus a new area for fall 2009. The page text is only the teaser; the video's content itself is not in the extracted text, so the planned features' details are not recorded here.
